environment.isolation: fresh rootless Podman container with a dedicated empty HOME and no inherited XDG state
environment.boundary: Clean Linux userspace/profile evidence with native X11 display forwarding; not an independent VM and not an external evaluator account.

degraded_readiness.observed_launcher_failure: libgdk-3.so.0: cannot open shared object file
degraded_readiness.defect_found: Readiness previously checked only the executable bit and did not detect unresolved native shared libraries.
degraded_readiness.repair: Added a high-severity launcher.dynamic_libraries ldd check and documented Fedora and Debian-family GTK3/WebKitGTK runtime packages.
degraded_readiness.post_repair_missing_library_evidence: missing shared libraries: libcairo.so.2, libdbus-1.so.3, libgdk-3.so.0, libgdk_pixbuf-2.0.so.0, libgtk-3.so.0, libjavascriptcoregtk-4.1.so.0, libsoup-3.0.so.0, libwebkit2gtk-4.1.so.0
degraded_readiness.recovery_instruction: Install the documented GTK3 and WebKitGTK 4.1 runtime packages, then rerun readiness.

native_x11_smoke.result: survived five-second bounded interval and was terminated by timeout
nonfatal_warnings: AT-SPI bus unavailable inside isolated container
EGL DRI2 screen unavailable inside isolated container

reset.defect_found: Native startup creates WebKit state under the previously undocumented XDG data root arda.launcher.
reset.repair: Added launcher_data to the validated readiness projection and safe-reset quarantine boundary; documented its override and retention policy.

uninstall.defect_found: Resolving an existing managed launcher symlink during layout construction aliased install_bin to its target and left a broken command symlink.
uninstall.repair: Managed launcher and desktop paths now remain lexical; a fresh-layout regression test proves uninstall removes the symlink.

limitations: This is a clean rootless container profile with an independent Fedora userspace, not a full VM or a separately logged-in human OS account.
The Manwe endpoint was configured for readiness classification but no provider request was made by this Workstream 6 run.
The native process smoke proves startup only; native objective-to-review click-through is covered by the separate Gate 3 evidence.
The invited external-evaluator gate remains open.
